events.summary: Measure agent-alone quota throughput using pre-bound PVs in Air-Gap E2E Stage D2 (scripts/e2e/burst_diagnosis.py, scripts/e2e/measure-prebound-burst.py, scripts/e2e/run-airgap-e2e.sh, scripts/e2e/test_prebound_burst.py, and .agents/evals/traces/2026-11-e2e-prebound-burst.json). Not touched: production Go code, quota logic, argv construction, RBAC, docs, or other workflows.

Air-Gap E2E run 43059690139 read binder-side on all three filesystems (binds per second 4.39 xfs, 3.61 ext4, 4.17 btrfs; applies per second 4.29, 3.61, 4.17), so the agent's own throughput was not measurable.

Stage D2 gains a second phase with PVs bound before the clock starts, printed between BEGIN/END E2E PREBOUND BURST JSON; binds all PVs first under a temporary provisioner gate (--process-all-nfs=false and 10m sync interval) and then lets the agent act via batch annotation under normal PV WATCH, with pod restart detection and finally restoration of resources and daemonset args; no production Go code changed.
bash -n, py_compile and the scripts/e2e unit tests (Ran 30 tests in 0.074s OK); no production Go code changed.
